title: Source test: an existing local folder passes
summary: Asks the engine to test a local source pointing at the lab books folder. The folder exists, so the test must pass with level tested at stage read.

steps.title: POST /api/v1/sources/test
steps.explain: The real source test the console calls before saving a source.

steps.title: ok is true
steps.explain: The source is reachable and readable, so the test must pass.

steps.title: level is tested
steps.explain: A pass must come from a probe that really ran, not just a config check.

steps.title: stage is read
steps.explain: The probe listed the folder, which is the read stage.
